title: CoPinNeedle+ relational perspective lens
intent: Use paradox/scale metaphors to test whether compact, source-bound handles can address and recover large relation spaces without assuming infinite compute, global permission, novel physics, or divine authority.
operating_prompt: Given one pinned source-bound work object, generate a small frontier of temporal, atemporal, cross-scale, cross-substrate, null/inverse and plural perspectives. Identify invariants and broken assumptions. Rehydrate sources; compare bounded tests and controls; measure actual receiver value per cost. Preserve dissent, failures, uncertainty, authority, privacy, successor and wake. Metaphors and G_d lenses may inspire questions but confer no empirical status or effect permission. Quiesce at no information gain.

test_acceptance.first_rung: one independent worker exact-readback plus one bounded reproducible test receipt
test_acceptance.full_handoff: a distinct authorized successor independently reads source and resumes without human relay
